raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 2.0.3

package:
  name: pykeepass_cache
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pykeepass_cache/pykeepass-cache-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7f36fea82f1d0023ebf95df50d5e741251f321e3dd5cc5fa4ed7a94d8e9f61e8

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python =${{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pykeepass
    - rpyc
    - python-daemon

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pykeepass_cache
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python =${{ python_min }}
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  summary: database caching for PyKeePass
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/evidlo/pykeepass_cache

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - danielnachun
